title: Webhooks
description: Learn how to set up and use webhooks to receive real-time notifications about events in your store.
content:
Webhooks

Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications about events in your store, enabling automation and integration with external systems.

What are Webhooks?

Webhooks are HTTP callbacks that notify external systems when specific events occur in your store:

  • Real-time notifications
  • Event-driven updates
  • Automated workflows
  • System integrations

Available Webhook Events

Tijraa supports webhooks for:

  • Order created
  • Order updated
  • Order cancelled
  • Payment received
  • Payment failed
  • Product created
  • Product updated
  • Customer created
  • Customer updated
  • Inventory updated

Creating a Webhook

Step 1: Access Webhooks

Navigate to Settings → Webhooks.

Step 2: Create Webhook

Click "Create Webhook".

Step 3: Configure Webhook

Set up webhook:

  • Webhook URL (endpoint to receive notifications)
  • Select events to subscribe to
  • HTTP method (POST)
  • Secret key (for verification)

Step 4: Test Webhook

Test the webhook to ensure it works correctly.

Step 5: Activate

Activate the webhook.

Webhook Payload

Webhook payloads include:

  • Event type
  • Event timestamp
  • Resource data
  • Webhook signature

Webhook Security

Secure your webhooks:

  • Use HTTPS endpoints
  • Verify webhook signatures
  • Use secret keys
  • Validate payloads
  • Implement rate limiting

Webhook Testing

Test webhooks:

  • Use test endpoints
  • Send test events
  • Verify payload format
  • Check response handling

Webhook Management

Manage your webhooks:

  • View all webhooks
  • Edit webhook settings
  • View webhook logs
  • Disable/enable webhooks
  • Delete webhooks

Webhook Logs

Monitor webhook activity:

  • View delivery status
  • Check response codes
  • Review payloads
  • Debug failures

Best Practices

  • Use HTTPS for webhook URLs
  • Verify webhook signatures
  • Handle errors gracefully
  • Implement retry logic
  • Monitor webhook health
  • Keep endpoints secure
